title: Turning off gym news also silently stops pop-ups for the member's own requests and orders
what: The 'Messages from my gym' switch says it is for gym news like a holiday, new timings or an offer. Turning it off removes the phone's push address from the gym, and that same address carries the answers to the member's own pause or renew request, 'your order is ready or cancelled', and 'the gym asked for your report'. Those pop-ups then stop with no word on the pause, renew or order screens. Only the trainer-question and Message-your-gym pages warn about it.
expected: The switch either covers news only and leaves the member's own answers alone, or its words and the request and order screens say that off also means no pop-up when the gym answers.
who: members who turn off gym news
how_often: every request or order answered while the switch is off
fix_line: Keep the push address for the member's own answers even when news is off, or say so on the switch and on those screens

title: A gym message can pop up with a sound in the middle of the night
what: When the instant push does not reach the phone, the phone's own background check picks up gym messages every 15 minutes or later, whenever Android lets it run. The phone has no quiet hours, so a message the gym sent in the evening can pop up with its sound at 1 or 3 am, hours after it was sent.
expected: Between about 10 pm and 7 am the phone keeps new gym messages silent (in the list or the inbox) and pops them up in the morning.
how_often: some nights, on phones where the push did not arrive
fix_line: Add a night window on the phone: show late messages without sound or hold them until morning

title: Plan ending and birthday reminders never pop up on screen; they only sound and wait in the list
what: The gym's automatic reminders are put on their own notification kind at normal importance. On Android that importance never shows a banner over the screen, unlike gym messages, which use high. So a 'your plan ends in 3 days' or birthday wish only makes a sound and sits in the pulled-down list, and is easy to miss, while the admin app talks of the member getting it.
expected: Reminders the gym counts on (plan ending, birthday) show as a pop-up like gym messages, or the owner's words say they arrive in the notification list only.
fix_line: Make the gym reminders kind high importance on new installs, or tell the owner it lands in the list

title: After switching gym messages off with no internet, pop-ups keep coming until the app is opened online
what: Switching 'Messages from my gym' off asks the gym to forget the phone's push address. With no internet that fails and is only tried again when the app comes back to the front. Until then each gym message still arrives, buzzes and is then taken away, and a member's own notes (order ready, pause answered) stay and ring.
expected: Off means nothing pops up or rings from that moment, even if the gym could not be told yet.
who: members who switch off while offline
fix_line: Have the phone drop every gym push itself while the switch is off, and retry the clear in the background
